title: awesome-silo plugins
description: plugins.yaml (categories and plugins) or a file in plugins.d (owners and plugins).

owners.description: plugins.d only: GitHub handles of the people who maintain this file.

categories.description: plugins.yaml only: the sections PLUGINS.md is grouped by, in display order.

manifests.description: Remote plugin manifests. Manifests in plugins.yaml come first, in order, then those in plugins.d files; a plugin ID provided earlier is skipped later. In plugins.d only tier "other" is allowed.

capability_categories.description: plugins.yaml only: maps a plugin capability type (for example metadata_provider.v1) to a category key. A manifest plugin is placed using its first mapped capability.

id.description: Short name, unique across all files; the snapshot is stored in the manifests directory as <id>.json.

category.description: Fallback category key for plugins none of whose capabilities are in capability_categories.

unsupported_plugins.description: Plugin IDs from this manifest that implement functionality outside Silo's supported scope and need an unsupported disclaimer.

url.description: https URL of the manifest JSON, fetched only by -update-manifests.

category.description: A category key from the categories section of plugins.yaml.

tier.description: official: maintained by the Silo project. community: maintained by the plugin's own community or author and endorsed or widely used. other: everything else.

url.description: Where to find the plugin: its homepage or repository.

oss.description: Source repository URL, if the plugin is open source.

unsupported.description: Displays a warning that Silo does not support this plugin and asking for support on an official Silo channel will result in a ban.
